rows.en: Epyon... That's some insane power and speed!!
What are you doing, Epyon!! Is that all the Zero System's power amounts to!?
Any means are fair to achieve the objective. You simply choose the optimal path!!
That's what the Zero System is, isn't it!?
This guy... He caught his own allies in the blast too!!
...It's turned out beautifully. The Zero System is going to be useful.
I won't let you do that!!
The Libra Cannon's control room is up ahead!! Stop it from firing!!
Got it!! You can leave this to us!!
Got it, leave it to us!!
Got it, leave it to us!!

notes.note: #0.38-42 end the 14-copy leader block begun at #0.29 in story_127; identical JP -> identical EN. Script 0648.bla shows the block as TextIdOffset+28+k (k=0 = #0.28, the distinct '...Epyon!!').

Speaker labels in 0648 run one row late (label on row N belongs to row N-1), confirmed against 0648.bla CharaNameIn calls: #0.44 Gaddess, #0.45 Epyon (silent), #0.46 Deathscythe Hell (CHARA 74) hit by Epyon.

#0.47-76 = 15 leader pairs (TextIdOffset+47+2k / +48+2k): 'Deathscythe...!!' then 'Epyon... what power and speed!!'. #0.62 rough wording (tondemonee) -> 'That's some insane'. #0.69 adds -san (polite leader); honorific dropped per style, so same EN as the others.
#0.77-79 Gaddess (CHARA 200, Hiling) goading Epyon. #0.78 is her description of the Zero System's logic: goal by any means, choose only the optimal path; subject 'you' restored.
#0.81-95: 15 leader pain cries (TextIdOffset+81+k). Each distinct JP cry given a distinct EN cry; katakana cries #0.91-95 rendered like the hiragana ones.
Ankh (CHARA 36; label sits on #0.97). Script then blows up the Virgo on Gaddess's side, so 'nakama' = Epyon's own allies caught in its attack; 'he' for Epyon per glossary g=m.
Gaddess, not Ankh (label shift). 'shiagari' = how Epyon has turned out/been tuned; 'tsukaeru' -> 'going to be useful'.
Sandrock (CHARA 76, polite Quatre) intercepting Epyon. #0.102 Heavyarms (CHARA 75, Trowa); #0.103 Birth (CHARA 78), who is part of the Gundam Team here (story_119/120). Libra Cannon per glossary.

#0.104-118: 15 leader replies (TextIdOffset+104+k), voiced from wording. ryoukai variants: shita 'Roger!!', da 'Roger that!!', bare 'Copy that!!', desu 'Understood!!'; wakarimashita 'Yes, understood!!'. Makasero/makasetoke/makasete kure = speaker offering the team ('leave it to us', 'Count on us'); 'us' since the leader answers for the whole party.

Uncertain leader mapping: the 0648.bla chain (9,10,6,7,15,14,5,4,3,8,13,12,11,2,1 = Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O, God, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1) fits the #0.8-22 block, but in the later blocks the polite variants (#0.69 -san, #0.115) fall on the Seven slot and the casual 'makasetoki na' on OOO's, so voicing was taken from wording, not from the chain.

report: 80/80 rows. Speaker labels in 0648 shifted one row late; speakers re-derived from 0648.bla (#0.97 is Gaddess, #0.96 Ankh, #0.100 Sandrock, #0.102 Heavyarms, #0.103 Birth). Leader-block chain does not fit the polite/casual wording in #0.47-76 and #0.104-118, so those were voiced from wording. #0.96 'allies' read as Epyon's own side (inferred from the script's explosion on the Virgo). No new names or terms.
